senses.gloss: m. (קָלָה II) roasting place; אפר מ׳ ashes from the roast, i.e. vegetable ashes, contrad. to אפר which includes any crumbled substance.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 15b:11">Ib. 15ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>ונותנין אפר וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Taanit 15b:11">ib.</cite>) <he>אפר מ׳ הן מביאין</he> they must bring wood-ashes (not dust, crushed bones &c.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 9:7">Par. IX, 7</cite> <he>אפר כשר שנתערב באפר מ׳</he> ashes fit for lustration (ashes of the red cow) which were mixed with wood-ashes.
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 10:1">Tosef. ib. X</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:1">IX</cite>), 1 <he>הרי הן כא׳ מ׳</he> they are as unfit for lustration as wood-ashes.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:12">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="M00724"><he>מַוֶּה</he> II</cite>.
